lp_hourly.query: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_with_cart_additions, sessions_that_reached_checkout, sessions_that_completed_checkout WHERE landing_page_path = '/products/outdoor-warming-heated-blanket-shawl' GROUP BY hour_of_day SINCE 2026-11-13 UNTIL 2026-11-13 ORDER BY hour_of_day ASC LIMIT 30

note: 11/13 18:5x取得。3WAY着る電気ブランケット 今日（Meta fresh・入口ページ時間別）。Shopify の今日の販売は0行（売上なし）
